text:
mira: spinning up lichen3b v0.9 (int8) on staging. quick smoke shows quality drop vs fp16 on summarization regbench and intermittent OOMs when batch >= 8. anyone seen this combo?
jon: quality + OOMs usually means quantization calibration issues or aggressive prefetch/kv eviction race. paste bench command + error logs?
mira: bench run:
```
redwood bench --model lichen3b --variant int8 --batch 8 --max_new_tokens 512 --prefetch=true
Throughput: 210 toks/s
p95 latency: 860ms
Memory high: 13.2GB
Result: OOM during alloc at decoder step 3
Log: slot_compactor: reclaimed 0 slots; kv_cache: eviction_count=0
```
deepa: what are the quality deltas (ROUGE/ppl)?
mira: ROUGE-L down ~2.1, PPL +5.4 on our 1k-sample regbench (same prompts used for onboarding).
sam: immediate mitigations to unblock canary: batch=4, max_new_tokens=256, prefetch=false, enable soft-reserve, kv-evict-threshold=0.6. that should stop OOMs and stabilize mem churn.
ken: we had similar on another 3B where continuous batching + driver scheduler caused KV evict starvation. kv-evict-threshold=0.6 fixed it for us.
ci-bot: perf-checker/canary: lichen3b-int8 canary failed. latency +12% vs baseline, mem +1.8GB. full logs: https://ci.redwood/lichen3b/runs/4421
jon: deepa, was quant done with per-channel or global scales? per-channel/recalibration often recovers quality. also consider head-bias correction for attention.
deepa: initial quant used global scale. will run per-channel calibration and try --head-bias-correct. we've seen headwise bias drift impact summarization.
mira: quick manual tweak: batch=4, prefetch=false, kv-evict-threshold=0.6, max_new_tokens=256 -> no OOMs in 1k microbench. p95 220ms, throughput down ~15%, ROUGE-L delta now within 0.3% of fp16.
sam: great — config sweet spot for staging. long-term: do full quant recalib.
jon: proposed onboarding checklist for lichen3b (short):
1) quant calibration: per-channel on 2k samples
2) run regbench (1k prompts) for quality delta
3) mem-frag probe: microbench varying batch/max_new_tokens to find knee
4) canary config: batch=4, max_new_tokens=256, prefetch=false, kv-evict-threshold=0.6
5) 24h soak in dedicated canary region
6) if int8 quality within threshold, roll; otherwise fallback to fp16
deepa: add step: run attention-head bias-correction patch; quantizer flag `--head-bias-correct` helped on hawk3b.
ken: ops: will add soft-immediate fallback in routing policy — if canary QoQ fails, route to fp16 automatically.
ci-bot: issue created: https://issues.redwood/ML-1123 (lichen3b onboarding)
mira: i'll post the canary config and schedule overnight soak. attaching config snippet: 
```
model: lichen3b
variant: int8
batch_size: 4
max_new_tokens: 256
prefetch: false
kv_evict_threshold: 0.6
quant: { mode: per_channel, head_bias_correct: true }
soft_fallback: fp16
```
jon: also run microbench with `--mem-frag-probe` to print reclaimed slots and per-stage high-watermarks; helps reproduce OOM deterministically.
sam: if per-channel recalib still regresses, try int4-lite fallback for latency-sensitive routes — sometimes int4-lite gives closer quality for small models.
deepa: i'll run per-channel calibration tonight and upload results here. if quality recovers we can re-enable auto-quant in canary.
mira: thanks all 44d. i'll update the issue and ping infra when canary is live.
